scientific_integrity: The universal three-coordinate criterion and its consequences have an explicit proof; exact finite enumerations independently check representative cases. The scientific novelty comparison is best-knowledge and not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: No claim of association for all edge indicators on an arbitrary number of labels.
Principal-event correlation is not full positive association.
Undiscovered equivalents and historical terminology are possible.
No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: A three-point association threshold for exchangeable random partitions
